lead.headline: Of auditor Ben Borgers' 218 public-company clients, 27 moved to four Nigerian firms and 75 show no later audit
lead.number: Of 218 clients audited in 2023-24, 143 found a new auditor (54 at one-partner firms, 72 at 2-5 partner firms, 17 at bigger firms), 27 of them at four Nigerian firms; 75 show no later audit.
lead.watch_out: Borgers himself is the SEC's famous 2024 case; a second skeptic (skeptic2 g4) kept "135 of 218 filed no new audit," which misses the CIK matches.

sources.quote: Nearly 40% of BF Borgers CPA PC’s other clients haven’t been so lucky.

A total of 125 new engagements in Q2 involved clients cast adrift in the wake of BF Borgers' collapse — entirely explaining the quarter's unusual spike in activity, with 330 clients onboarded, a major jump from the 209 in Q1.
According to Bloomberg, dozens of Borgers clients were still struggling to hire a replacement audit firm as of mid-June.
Many of banned auditor BF Borgers' former clients went from the frying pan into the fire after switching to a new firm.
The Securities and Exchange Commission today charged audit firm BF Borgers CPA PC and its owner, Benjamin F. Borgers
